<!-- DO NOT EDIT | GENERATED CONTENT -->

Launch a tested recipe, and point the active profile and Coder at it.

To bring the current model back up without switching, use "vllm-helper restart":
it drives whichever runner the active profile belongs to.

## Usage

```console
vllm-helper recipes launch <id> [flags]
```

## Options

### --container-name

|         |                        |
| ------- | ---------------------- |
| Type    | <code>string</code>    |
| Default | <code>vllm-node</code> |

container name on each node

### --dry-run

|      |                   |
| ---- | ----------------- |
| Type | <code>bool</code> |

print what would run and change nothing

### --iface

|      |                     |
| ---- | ------------------- |
| Type | <code>string</code> |

cluster interface to use instead of the discovered one

### --master-port

|         |                    |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Type    | <code>int</code>   |
| Default | <code>29501</code> |

rendezvous port for the ranks

### --no-activate

|      |                   |
| ---- | ----------------- |
| Type | <code>bool</code> |

launch only; leave the active profile and Coder alone

### --nodes

|         |                          |
| ------- | ------------------------ |
| Type    | <code>stringSlice</code> |
| Default | <code>[]</code>          |

registry node names in rank order; rank 0 serves the API

### --ssh-key

|      |                     |
| ---- | ------------------- |
| Type | <code>string</code> |

private key for reaching non-head nodes
